messages:
theo_ng: Postmortem follow-up: recurring paging from inference autoscaler and short CPU spikes. Need owners + due dates for alert tuning (dedupe, thresholds, paging lanes).

priya_s: Can we capture the concrete fixes here so we can split work?

theo_ng: TL;DR: (A) dedupe by hostpool+error_signature instead of service. (B) change transient spike alerts to require 3 of 5 1m windows before paging. (C) add autoscale alert cooldown during backup windows. (D) stop duplicate routing to infra-oncall + infra-ops. (E) nightly prune job to collapse duplicates older than 1h.

carlos_m: I can own (A) and (E). Plan: update alert matcher to use stack_hash tag and add a small lambda to collapse dup alerts into a single ticket. Due: 2026-04-01.

priya_s: I'll take (B) and docs. Implement rolling-window expression and add p99 guard so we don't lose real regressions. Due: 2026-03-30.

theo_ng: I'll coordinate (C) with infra and run the canary for one service first for 48h. Backup windows: daily 00:30-01:30 UTC + Wed snapshot 03:00-04:00 UTC. Target: 2026-04-02.

carlos_m: Routing fix (D) — I'll update routing policy so only infra-ops gets escalation for infra-wide pages. Will run canary for payments. Due: 2026-03-31.

oncall-bot: Postmortem linked PMT-2026-0999. Actions created: https://redwood.internal/trackers/alerts/pm-0999

priya_s: Quick config snippet for windowed rule I'll apply: `count_over_time(rate(req[1m]) > X)[5m:1m] >= 3` then page.

carlos_m: Dedup snippet: `group_by: ["hostpool","stack_hash"]
dedupe_window: 10m`. Will include hostpool mapping for cross-AZ collapse.

theo_ng: Success criteria: run 72h noise-check after rollouts. If pages/day falls >50% and user-facing latency is unchanged, we close items.

priya_s: I'll add dashboard panels for pages/day by rule and p95 latency and post link here.

oncall-bot: Actions updated in tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/alerts/2026-03-noise-cleanup

carlos_m: Capturing recurring pattern as `recurring:backup-flap`. Monthly review scheduled; owner infra-eng, assignee: priya_s, due: 2026-04-12.

theo_ng: Thanks everyone. Use this thread for canary status and rollback notes. :thumbsup:

priya_s: Will post canary results after first 24h.
